subject: NovusAI MAP draft & procurement signature runway — closeplay proposal
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@novusai.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@novusai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: NovusAI MAP draft & procurement signature runway — closeplay proposal

Hi Claire / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — great to hear more about your Q1 rollout requirements and the integration window for the personalization pipeline. Per our conversation, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out milestones, owners, and a proposed target close date. High-level notes up front: 

- Target close: 2026-02-05 (proposal requires procurement signature by 2026-02-01 to meet onboarding window)
- Critical dependency: legal review + IP appendix (Novus legal) — we recommend starting redline week of Jan 12
- Onboarding milestone: infra readiness and test token provisioning by 02/12 to enable a 2-week validation period before GA

Attachments: NovusAI_MAP_v1.2.pdf (draft MAP), NovusAI_procurement_checklist.xlsx (procurement items we typically need).

Next steps I propose: 
1) You review the MAP draft and flag any milestone/owner changes by EOD Tue 2026-01-12.
2) If procurement needs a separate calendar invite, loop them in and we’ll add a procurement-only checklist walkthrough.
3) Ben / Marissa — can you confirm our recommended SOW cadence and whether we should propose a two-phase invoice schedule tied to the onboarding milestones?

I’ll keep the doc editable — happy to turn this into a shared Google MAP if you prefer collaborative editing.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: NovusAI_MAP_v1.2.pdf (23 KB)]
[Attachment: NovusAI_procurement_checklist.xlsx (14 KB)]

From: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@novusai.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@novusai.com>, procurement@novusai.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovusAI MAP draft & procurement signature runway — closeplay proposal

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear milestone layout. A few quick clarifying Qs from our side before we discuss internally: 

1) The MAP calls out a "legal review" milestone — can you confirm how long Redwood typically needs for contract redlines once Novus provides feedback?
2) Procurement asked if we can push the signature deadline back one week (to 2026-02-08) because of a board meeting on Feb 2. Would that break your onboarding window?
3) Who at Redwood will be the primary contact for security docs (SOC/Security questionnaire)?

I’ll consolidate and get back with a proposed internal timeline. If procurement is on board for Feb 8, we’ll surface any blockers by Tue.

—Claire
Director, Product Ops | NovusAI

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovusAI MAP draft & procurement signature runway — internal notes

Looping internal owners — answers for Claire: 

- Contract redlines: Typical turnaround is 48–72 hours for straightforward edits; complex legal terms (data residency / indemnity) can extend to 5–7 business days. We should flag anything that touches data residency ASAP.
- Onboarding: Our onboarding runbook assumes a signed SOW + initial invoice received at least 5 business days before infra provisioning. Pushing signature to 02/08 would compress provisioning but still viable if procurement can provide a signed DocuSign by EOD 02/08 and Novus completes the checklist immediately.
- Security docs: Dev will own SOC2 questionnaire and evidence collection; I’ll coordinate a brief sync with Novus security.

Action items for our side: Marissa — draft two invoice schedule language (30% upfront, 70% on completion of validation) and share redline-friendly clause snippets. Dev — prepare the SOC2 questionnaire skeleton and a list of expected evidence.

Ben
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@novusai.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@novusai.com>, procurement@novusai.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovusAI MAP draft & procurement signature runway — closeplay proposal

Quick update from our side: Procurement confirmed internal timeline but cannot promise signature before Feb 8 (board window is fixed). They asked whether Redwood can accept a signed SOW by Feb 8 and allow a one-week provisioning overlap (i.e., start config work under an acceptance letter while DocuSign completes). Procurement is willing to sign an intake/acceptance note to enable a soft start.

Also attached: our procurement intake form (they filled the top section). We flagged the IP appendix as a possible negotiation point.

If you can accept Feb 8 signature with intake acceptance, we'll aim to finalize MAP milestone owners and return edits by Wed 2026-01-14.

Claire

[Attachment: NovusAI_procurement_intake.pdf (12 KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@novusai.com>, procurement@novusai.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovusAI MAP draft & procurement signature runway — closeplay proposal

Claire / procurement team — thanks for the update and for being transparent about the board date. Confirming Redwood's position: we can accept a signed SOW by 2026-02-08 provided Novus executes an intake/acceptance note that covers the minimal provisioning work we need to start (non-production config, security questionnaire kickoff, connectivity tests). Key bullets below for the acceptance note: 

- Acceptance note permits up to 5 business days of non-production provisioning work prior to DocuSign completion.
- Procurement to acknowledge outstanding IP appendix negotiations and route any redlines to legal by 2026-01-21.
- Provisioning window: if DocuSign is delayed beyond 2026-02-12, Redwood reserves the right to reschedule GA to preserve capacity SLAs (we'll provide alternate dates).

Ben / Marissa / Dev — please review the three bullets and confirm we can ship the intake note template to Claire by EOD today so procurement can sign off. Once Claire confirms owners' list on Wed (1/14), I’ll push a shared MAP link and lock milestone owners.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Novus scheduled.

Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: NovusAI_MAP_v1.2.pdf (revised with inline owner comments)]
